findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_gaps, check_product_link, search_products, get_setup_and_upgrade_links · Private data: get_setup_and_upgrade_links · Public sink: list_gaps, report_not_found, get_setup_and_upgrade_links.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_gaps, check_product_link, search_products, get_setup_and_upgrade_links · Private data: get_setup_and_upgrade_links · Public sink: list_gaps, report_not_found, get_setup_and_upgrade_links

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
